name: bricks/render-elements
label: Render elements
description: Render HTML + CSS for a proposed Bricks element tree without saving, or omit elements to render a post's current saved tree. Use responseFormat `summary` for compact post-save verification. Read-only.

postId.description: The post/page/template ID to use as rendering context. When elements are omitted, the ability renders this post's current saved Bricks tree.

elements.description: Optional proposed Bricks element tree. Omit after a save to render the current stored tree without reading and resending it.

area.description: Optional frozen Bricks area. When supplied, it must match the target post or template area.

responseFormat.description: Use `summary` for compact post-save verification of generated markup, landmarks, headings, and responsive CSS. Default `detailed` returns full HTML and CSS.

css.description: Generated inline CSS for the elements.

summary.description: Compact render verification when responseFormat is summary.
